subject: ForgePlus × Redwood: SDK interop pilot and lightweight tracing + safety gating
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@forgeplus.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood interop – lightweight trace & prompt-safety pilot idea

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at the summit — ForgePlus loved the Redwood demo. We’ve been talking internally about a small scoped pilot to validate two things: (1) instrumenting LangChain/LlamaIndex calls made through our SDK so we can reconcile latency/cost at token granularity, and (2) a lightweight prompt-safety gating hook that lets our customers opt-in to Redwood’s pre-send safety checks.

Proposed quick scope:
- 2-week sandbox: attach ForgePlus SDK v0.9 -> Redwood hosted endpoint (dev key)
- Trace surface: per-request latency, model name, token counts, and top-3 prompt templates used
- Safety hook: a pre-send API that returns allow/warn/block with a short message
- Joint evaluation: 10 representative prompts (we’ll share), success = trace telemetry + safety policy fired as expected

I attached a very rough pilot map and a one-row mutual action plan. Are you the right person to sync on technical owners and timing? We could start next week.

Cheers,
Asha
Asha Rao
Head of Integrations, ForgePlus
[Attachment: forgeplus-redwood-pilot-map.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@forgeplus.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood interop – lightweight trace & prompt-safety pilot idea

Hi Asha — great to meet you at the summit, and thanks for the clear proposal. I’m happy to run point from Redwood. Karthik (runtime/instrumentation) and Marissa (ISV partnerships) are looped in.

Quick responses:
- Scope looks reasonable for a 2-week sandbox, provided we keep the initial environment to our hosted dev cluster (no dedicated capacity yet).
- Tracing: we can expose an SDK shim that emits token counts and model meta to our tracing pipeline; need to confirm the exact fields.
- Safety hook: we can offer a synchronous pre-send endpoint with a 150ms median budget in our hosted env — we’ll validate in the sandbox.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Karthik and Asha do a 30m technical sync to align on telemetry schema and authentication.
2) Marissa + Asha finalize mutual_action_plan.xlsx and success criteria.
3) We spin up a dev key and workspace (Redwood side) and share credentials.

Can you do Tue 16th 11:00am PT for the tech sync?

Thanks — excited to run this.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha@forgeplus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood interop – lightweight trace & prompt-safety pilot idea

Thanks Vanessa. Hi Asha — short notes from the sync and actions (sending as thread reply so everyone has the log).

Takeaways:
- Telemetry model: ForgePlus will emit a single JSON envelope per request (we looked at your SDK hook). Required fields we’ll consume: request_id, model, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, elapsed_ms, customer_id, prompt_template_id. Optional: prompt_snippet (first 256 chars).
- Auth: ForgePlus will use a short-lived dev token we issue; we’ll provide a workspace-scoped API key and instructions for rotating every 24h during the sandbox.
- Safety hook semantics: POST /v1/pre_send_check with payload {request_id, prompt_text, customer_id}. Response should be {decision: allow|warn|block, message: string, policy_id: string?}. Good to keep small.
- Timing: we validated end-to-end should fit 150–200ms p95 for simple rules; heavier classifiers may exceed that — we’ll surface metrics.

Action items:
- ForgePlus: attach SDK branch that calls our dev endpoint and include a small test harness (Asha/Ravi).
- Redwood: provision dev key, create tracing ingestion tag (forgeplus-pilot), and add a dashboard template. (Vivek / Karthik)
- Both: populate the mutual_action_plan.xlsx with exact prompt list and success criteria. (Marissa owner for Redwood)

I’ll open a minimal API spec in the shared Drive and drop a quick curl example. Vivek, can you provision the workspace?

—Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
